manifest.name: Notes
manifest.description: Personal and shared Markdown notes on the cluster and its objects: runbooks, hand-overs and reminders, with tags, search and pins.

access.viewer: Your role on this cluster is viewer. Shared notes are written by operators and administrators.
access.notAuthor: Only its author or an administrator can delete a shared note.

filters.allClusters: Include my notes on other clusters

sidebar.empty: No notes yet. Notes you write here are personal unless you share them.
sidebar.truncated: Showing the first notes only; narrow the search to see the rest.

editor.title: Title
editor.tagsHelp: Separated by commas or spaces, e.g. runbook, incident
editor.globalHelp: A personal note that is not tied to the current cluster.
editor.sharedWarning: Shared notes are visible to every user of cluster {{cluster}}. Do not put passwords, tokens or other secrets here.
editor.conflict: This note was changed since you opened it.

errors.titleTooLong: The title can have at most {{max}} characters.
errors.bodyTooLarge: The text can be at most {{max}} KiB.
errors.tagInvalid: “{{tag}}” is not a tag: use letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-' (at most 40).
errors.tooManyTags: A note can have at most {{max}} tags.

delete.title: Delete note?
delete.messagePersonal: The note “{{title}}” will be deleted permanently.
delete.messageShared: The shared note “{{title}}” will be deleted permanently for every user of this cluster.

resource.title: Notes on {{object}}
resource.emptyHint: Personal notes are visible only to you; shared notes to every user of the cluster.
